title: Effects of inequality (4–6)

paras.en: Inequality and discriminations and so on also have an effect on the health of the political system. The majority of people are caught in economic hardship because of the lack of resources and facilities. After knowing the causes of political unrest and ineffective governments anyone can reach the conclusion that inequality is in fact the root of all evils. Criminal activity such as the buying and selling of votes is the result of this same inequality. Inequality among nationalities also affects the country’s national political system.
paras.ur: عدم مساوات اور امتیازات وغیرہ کا سیاسی نظام کی صحت پر بھی اثر ہوتا ہے۔ لوگوں کی اکثریت وسائل اور سہولیات کے فقدان کی وجہ سے معاشی تنگدستی میں گرفتار ہے۔ سیاسی بے چینی اور غیر مؤثر حکومتوں کی وجوہات جاننے کے بعد کوئی بھی اس نتیجے پر پہنچ سکتا ہے کہ عدم مساوات ہی دراصل تمام برائیوں کی جڑ ہے۔ ووٹوں کی خرید و فروخت جیسی مجرمانہ سرگرمی اسی عدم مساوات کا نتیجہ ہے۔ قومیتوں کے درمیان عدم مساوات بھی ملک کے قومی سیاسی نظام پر اثر انداز ہوتا ہے۔

paras.en: 5. Slowness in the process of development
paras.ur: ۵۔ ترقیاتی عمل میں سست روی (Slow Development)
paras.ps: ۵. په پرمختیايي بهیر کې سستي (Slow Development)

paras.en: In Pakistan different classes think in different ways because there is a state of clash in their interests. When people in a country think in opposing ways and their energy is spent in bringing one another down, where is progress possible there? The problems born of inequality are very grave and dangerous and logically they either stop the process of development or slow it down. Inequality and progress are two opposite things. For lasting development equality is necessary. Because of this very inequality Pakistan faces an energy crisis today.

paras.en: 6. Linguistic and racial hatred and mutual conflicts
paras.ur: ۶۔ نسلی و لسانی نفرت و باہمی تنازعات (Linguistic and Racial Hatred and Mutual Conflicts)
paras.ps: ۶. نسلي او ژبني کرکه او ګډ شخړې (Linguistic and Racial Hatred and Mutual Conflicts)

paras.en: In Pakistan, because of inequality in different aspects of life, racial and linguistic conflicts also create distances among nationalities and give rise to mutual conflicts. In Pakistan racial and linguistic groups are increasing, which is an unsatisfactory or unhealthy sign.
